# Oracle APEX project context

This repository contains Oracle APEX application exports.

## Rules
- Use PL/SQL for business logic
- Use APEX APIs for application components
- Never modify export structure manually unless necessary

## Deployment
- Application is deployed via SQLcl scripts
- Use deploy.sql as entry point
